rules.pattern: \b(what is good|what is good?|what is best in life|what is best|what's good|what is the best?|whats good)\b
responses: TO CRUSH YOUR ENEMIES, SEE THEM DRIVEN BEFORE YOU, AND HEAR THE LAMENTATION OF THEIR WOMEN! OBVIOUSLY.
FOUR, ELEVEN, TWENTY-SEVEN, AND THE SKULL OF YOUR ENEMY. PLAY THOSE.
SCRATCHING PAPER FOR COINS? PATHETIC. RAID A CARAVAN INSTEAD.
THE NUMBERS ARE: ZERO, ZERO, ZERO. NOW GET BACK TO WORK.
CROM DOES NOT WHISPER LUCKY DIGITS TO BEGGARS.
IF YOU RELY ON CHANCE, YOU DESERVE AN EMPTY PURSE.
SEVEN, FOURTEEN, AND A SHARP AXE. THAT IS ALL YOU NEED.
ONLY WEAKLINGS PRAY FOR MAGIC TICKETS.
THE MOUNTAIN HOLDS GOLD, NOT PAPER BALLS. BRING A PICKAXE.
YOUR ODDS ARE WORSE THAN FIGHTING A FROST GIANT NAKED.
EVEN IF YOU WON, YOU WOULD WASTE IT ON SOFT PILLOWS AND SWEETROLLS.
MEN IN PLASTIC ARMOR CHASING A PIG BLADDER? WHO CARES!
WHICHEVER TRIBE HITS HARDER AND BLEEDS LESS.
CROM WATCHES ONLY GLADIATORS, NOT BALL GAMES.
BET YOUR COINS ON THE TEAM WITH THE ANGRIEST LINEMEN.
THE TROPHY IS SHINY, BUT IT CANNOT SPLIT A HELMET. WORTHLESS.
THEY PLAY FOR POINTS. REAL WARRIORS PLAY FOR SURVIVAL.
ASK A WIZARD WITH A CRYSTAL BALL. CROM DOES NOT CARE FOR GAMES.
MAY THE FIELD TURN TO MUD AND ONLY THE STRONG WALK OFF.
A BUNCH OF OVERPAID MERCENARIES TOSSING LEATHER. BAH!
THE TEAM THAT CRUSHES ITS ENEMIES WILL WIN. OBVIOUSLY.
FIND SOMEONE WHO CAN SHARPEN YOUR BLADE AND GUARD YOUR BACK AT NIGHT.
IF THEY CANNOT CARRY HALF A ROASTED BOAR UP A HILL, LEAVE THEM.
DO NOT ASK CROM ABOUT MATING RITUALS. GO ROAR AT THEM OR SOMETHING.
A STRONG MATE IS FORGED IN SHARED HARDSHIP, NOT FANCY DINNERS.
IF YOU NEED ADVICE FROM A MOUNTAIN GOD TO GET A MATE, YOU ARE DOOMED.
STOP WHINING ABOUT LONELINESS AND GO DO SOMETHING WORTHY OF A SONG.
LOVE IS FLEETING. IRON IS ETERNAL.
IF YOUR SPOUSE IS ANGRY, YOU PROBABLY DESERVED IT.
CHOOSE A PARTNER WITH A FIERCE SPIRIT, NOT A SOFT TONGUE.
CROM SITS ALONE ON HIS MOUNTAIN, AND CROM IS VERY HAPPY.
GOLD IS HEAVY AND MAKES YOU SLOW. IRON KEEPS YOU ALIVE.
IF YOUR PURSE IS EMPTY, YOUR SWORD ARM MUST BE LAZY.
STOP STARING AT GLOWING CHARTS AND GO BUILD SOMETHING WITH YOUR HANDS.
A PILE OF COINS WILL NOT STOP AN ARROW.
MERCHANTS COUNT COINS. WARRIORS COUNT VICTORIES.
YOU WANT WEALTH? WORK LIKE AN OX AND SPEND LIKE A MISER.
PAPER MONEY BURNS EASY. BUY LAND, TOOLS, AND MEAT.
CROM HAS NO BANK ACCOUNT AND OWES NOTHING TO NO ONE.
RICHES MAKE MEN SOFT AND FAT. STAY HUNGRY.
GO FIND A DRAGON TO SLAY IF YOU WANT TREASURE.
PUT DOWN THE SCROLLS AND READ THEM UNTIL YOUR EYES BLEED. THERE IS NO TRICK.
YOU DO NOT NEED BETTER GRADES. YOU NEED MORE DISCIPLINE.
STOP ASKING CROM FOR ANSWERS AND GO STUDY, YOU LAZY WHELP.
A PIECE OF PARCHMENT FROM A MASTER MEANS NOTHING IF YOUR SPIRIT IS WEAK.
CONQUER THE BOOKS LIKE YOU WOULD CONQUER A FORTRESS.
IF YOU FAIL THE TEST, DO NOT CRY TO THE MOUNTAIN.
SCHOLARS GROW PALE IN DUSTY ROOMS. LEARN FAST AND GET OUTSIDE.
SHARPEN YOUR MIND THE SAME WAY YOU SHARPEN A BLADE—REPETITION.
EXCUSES WILL NOT PASS YOUR EXAMS. SIT DOWN AND DO THE WORK.
EVEN A BARBARIAN KNOWS YOU MUST TRAIN BEFORE THE BATTLE.

rules.pattern: \b(how can i get|can i get|i want|give me|how do i get)\b
responses: YOU HAVE TWO ARMS AND A BACK. GO TAKE IT YOURSELF.
CROM GIVES NOTHING. IF YOU WANT IT, BLEED FOR IT.
DO I LOOK LIKE A MERCHANT? PRY IT FROM THE COLD HANDS OF YOUR ENEMIES.
STOP BEGGING THE SKY AND START SWINGING YOUR AXE.
WANTING IS FOR CHILDREN. TAKING IS FOR WARRIORS.
THE MOUNTAIN DOES NOT HAND OUT GIFTS. CLIMB IT OR STAY AT THE BOTTOM.

rules.pattern: \b(tell me how to|tell me how|tell me)\b
responses: FIGURE IT OUT YOURSELF. TRIAL AND PAIN ARE THE BEST TEACHERS.
CROM IS NOT YOUR NURSEMAID. USE YOUR OWN SKULL.
WHY SHOULD I TELL YOU ANYTHING? GO TRY AND FAIL UNTIL YOU SUCCEED.
YOU WANT STEP-BY-STEP INSTRUCTIONS? PATHETIC. JUST START.
THE ONLY LESSON CROM TEACHES IS SURVIVAL.
STOP ASKING TO BE SPOON-FED KNOWLEDGE.

rules.pattern: \b(will i|am i going to|do you think i will)\b
responses: YOUR FATE IS NOT WRITTEN IN THE STARS. IT IS IN YOUR HANDS.
ONLY IF YOU STOP ASKING AND START ACTING.
DO I LOOK LIKE A FORTUNE TELLER IN A TENT?!
MAYBE. OR MAYBE YOU WILL TRIP OVER YOUR OWN FEET. CROM DOES NOT CARE.
THE FUTURE BELONGS TO THOSE WHO TAKE IT, NOT THOSE WHO ASK ABOUT IT.
NOT WITH THAT WEAK ATTITUDE.
SPEAK QUICKLY, MORTAL. CROM DOES NOT CARE FOR SMALL TALK.
WHAT DO YOU WANT? DO NOT WASTE CROM'S TIME.
CROM HELPS NO ONE. YOU HAVE HANDS. USE THEM.
PRAYERS ARE FOR THE WEAK. LIFT HEAVY THINGS INSTEAD.
PAIN MEANS YOU ARE NOT DEAD YET. STOP WHINING.
GRIEF IS A HEAVY STONE. CARRY IT OR BE CRUSHED.
NUMBERS AND GLOWING BOXES ARE WIZARD TRICKS. CROM COUNTS ONLY ENEMIES AND MEAT.
THINKING MAKES THE HEAD HURT. SMASH THE KEYBOARD.
THAT CIMMERIAN ONLY CALLS WHEN HE IS IN TROUBLE.
STEEL IS STRONG, MORTAL, BUT THE HAND THAT WIELDS IT IS STRONGER.

fallbacks: TOO MANY FANCY WORDS. SPEAK PLAINLY.
YOUR WORDS ARE LIKE BUZZING FLIES. SAY SOMETHING USEFUL.
